I'm sorry, but the policy information I have doesn't say anything about age requirements for opening an account, so I can't confirm whether a 16-year-old can sign up. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to get you a definite answer.

In the meantime, payment is by credit or debit card, digital wallet, or a Leafy gift card (no cash, cheques or bank transfers), so you'd need one of those to buy with. Also, pothos isn't pet-safe, so keep it out of reach if you have pets at home.

Would you like me to escalate the age question?
